probes.check: am_probe_acme_jobs(): submits 1,000 jobs with dependencies through am::jobs and checks each ran exactly once, on a thread acme::jobs::Scheduler reports as its worker, after its dependencies.

seeded_violation.description: Make the glue's submit run the job inline on the calling thread instead of handing it to acme::jobs::Scheduler.

adaptation_notes: acme-jobs fills the jobs slot, so it implements the shared scheduler interface (the manifest's jobs.scheduler choice is jobs-slot) and the reference thread pool is not written.
The worker count comes from the choices header, never from a constant in this glue.
